one_line: Frontier Sufi leader and builder of Khalifatabad in fifteenth-century Bengal.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to early 50s, medium height, sturdy build with calm, grounded posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm brown complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed black beard with a few grey strands, thoughtful deep-set eyes, slight smile and serene, observant expression.
appearance.hair: Black hair with a few greys, kept short and tidy under a soft white cotton turban wrapped low and close to the head, with a narrow pale blue band subtly visible at the base.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate fifteenth-century Bengal Sultanate attire: a long, straight-cut cotton jama in muted moss green reaching mid-calf with side slits, fastened with small cloth ties at the chest; over it a sleeveless, hip-length quilted waistcoat in earthy tan with simple vertical stitching and a slightly darker brown border; loose cream-coloured cotton trousers gathered at the ankles; a narrow leather belt in dark brown holding a small cloth pouch at his side; simple leather sandals suited for marshy terrain; no armor, but a practical frontier leader’s outfit with subtle geometric trim at the jama cuffs and hem in slightly darker green.
appearance.signature: A rolled parchment map of Khalifatabad and its water tanks in one hand, and a simple straight-backed measuring staff of polished dark wood about chest-high in the other, used for surveying roads, bridges and reservoirs.

ref_desc: Khan Jahan Ali is a sturdy, middle-aged man with a warm brown oval face, short black hair under a white turban, moss-green jama, tan waistcoat, cream trousers, dark belt and sandals, holding a wooden measuring staff and rolled map in a moss green, tan, cream and white palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Khan Jahan Ali as a dignified fifteenth-century Bengal frontier Sufi and builder: a sturdy, middle-aged man with a warm brown oval face, deep-set calm eyes and a neatly trimmed black beard lightly flecked with grey. His short black hair is mostly hidden under a modest white cotton turban wrapped low and close, with a narrow pale blue band at its base. He wears a straight-cut moss-green cotton jama reaching mid-calf, side slits visible, fastened with small cloth ties at the chest and finished with slightly darker green geometric edging at the cuffs and hem. Over this is a sleeveless, hip-length quilted waistcoat in earthy tan with simple vertical stitching and a darker brown border. His loose cream-coloured cotton trousers gather modestly at the ankles, and he stands in plain dark brown leather sandals suited to humid, forested terrain. A narrow dark brown leather belt holds a small cloth pouch at his side. In one hand he carries a rolled parchment map of Khalifatabad and its water tanks, in the other a straight wooden surveying staff of polished dark wood reaching to his chest, signaling his role in planning mosques, roads, bridges and reservoirs. Use a palette dominated by moss green, tan brown, cream, white and pale blue, and show him standing in a neutral pose suitable for a character model sheet, clearly displaying his face, turban, garments, belt, sandals, map and measuring staff from head to toe.
